claim_boundary: A pass supports development transport of the frozen algorithm across the registered six-to-ten-item cycle family and three backbones. N=6 and N=10 are outside the backbone's N=8 meta-training distribution. Item count intentionally co-varies with support-relation count N, support trials 4N, query count N(N-1)/2, and direct-query fraction 2/(N-1), while holding mean support degree at two. The result does not establish arbitrary size scaling, retrained size-general learning, network-population prevalence, or a human/biological mechanism.
known_limitations_carried_forward: N=6 and N=10 are strict cardinality OOD tests
item count co-varies with support count, support duration, query count, and direct-query fraction
density progressively regularizes individualized global order in the prior N=8 audit
excessive symbolic-distance slope remains a separate global-policy problem

registered_outcome_tree.FUNCTIONAL_ASYMMETRY_NOT_ITEM_COUNT_TRAN: All cells are competent and interpretable, N=8 replays, but neither N=6 nor N=10 transports the complete division. Retain eight-item Liu mechanism and reject cardinality transport.
registered_outcome_tree.ITEM_COUNT_COMPETENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Any N=6/10 cell fails intact learned or nonlearned competence. Its mechanism result is non-interpretable; report the OOD boundary without tuning or retraining within this contract.
registered_outcome_tree.ITEM_COUNT_DEPENDENT_OR_UNRESOLVED: At least one but not all item counts transports, or a primary link is heterogeneous across competent backbones. Localize only registered size and link effects; do not add sizes or retrain post hoc.
registered_outcome_tree.LIU_ITEM_COUNT_MECHANISM_TRANSPORTED: N=6,8,10 all transport. Promote the frozen asymmetric organization as development-supported across the registered item-count range while retaining the OOD and co-variation boundaries.
registered_outcome_tree.NONINTERPRETABLE_EXECUTION: Any source, artifact, enumeration, variable-item interface, N=8 replay, GPU-runtime, tensor-freeze, shape, orientation, finite-value, or exact-reassembly gate fails. Repair execution under a separately recorded lock without changing the science.
registered_outcome_tree.cell: A size-backbone cell passes only if all eight links and all source, artifact, graph-enumeration, size-interface, GPU-runtime, tensor-freeze, orientation, finite-value, exactness, and N=8 replay gates pass.
registered_outcome_tree.size: An item count transports only if all three mandatory backbones pass independently.

registered_primary_links.P_off_a_on_direct_nontransitive: Within every cell, P-off/a-on learned correct-probability lower bound exceeds 0.50 and learned-minus-nonlearned lower bound exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.P_off_global_collapse: Within every cell, P-off/a-on nonlearned correct-probability upper bound is at most 0.55 and P-off local remote minus 0.25 times intact global remote upper bound is below zero.
registered_primary_links.P_remote_reassembly: Within every cell, global a-off disjoint relation-LOO and third-party relational lower bounds both exceed zero.
registered_primary_links.a_off_direct_loss: Within every cell, intact minus a-off learned correct-probability lower bound exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.constructive_global_structure: Within every cell, intact and a-off Hodge-fraction lower bounds are at least 0.95, intact transitive-triplet lower bound is at least 0.95, and intact Hodge-order tau-to-true lower bound exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.exact_local_compression: Every finite-value and shape gate passes, and common-float64 tensor-state and all-query raw-read reconstruction maximum absolute errors are each at most 1e-12.
registered_primary_links.intact_competence: Within every cell, participant-bootstrap lower bounds for intact learned and nonlearned exact decision accuracy both exceed 0.50.
registered_primary_links.size_normalized_individualized_stable_st: Within every cell, at least two eligible non-correct subjects exist, the mean inter-subject order-tau upper bound is below 0.80, and the bootstrap lower bound for mean 80-percent-stable-error pair density among eligible non-correct subjects is above zero. Report but do not gate the size-dependent probability of at least one stable error.
